editNote: Activation from the book (p.291): it prints 'Activate [one-action] (manipulate)'; AoN has two actions. The book's errata is silent on belladonna; the 3-to-2-action change AoN may have followed is errata to the pre-Remaster rulebook for injury poisons, and belladonna is ingested.
